name: Discover it Student Chrome
balance_transfer_fee: 5% on transfers posted at a promotional APR, none at the standard Transfer APR
late_payment_fee: None the first time you pay late, up to $41 after that

welcome_bonus.bonus: Cashback Match, which doubles every dollar of cash back you earn in your first year
welcome_bonus.requirement: automatic on all cash back earned from account approval through your first 365 days, with no minimum spend and no cap, paid within two billing periods

verdict.text: No activation to remember, but no $100 bonus and a lower ceiling

earn_rates.category: Gas stations: first $1,000/quarter combined with restaurants, then 1%
Restaurants: first $1,000/quarter combined with gas stations, then 1%

earn_note: Nothing needs activating, which is the reason to pick this over the rotating-category student card. The cost is a low ceiling: gas and restaurants share one $1,000 quarterly cap, worth at most $10 a quarter over the base, and there is no $100 bonus. Cashback Match doubles year one.

redemption_options.method: Partner gift cards, which carry at least 5% added value
Statement credit or deposit to a bank account

points.note: Cash back is a flat 1 cent as a statement credit or a bank deposit, with no minimum and no expiry while the account is open. Partner gift cards carry a guaranteed 5% minimum added value, so $47.50 of rewards buys a $50 card, and rotating merchant promotions have reached 15% to 25% on names like Apple, Uber, Instacart and Chipotle. The gift card minimum rose from $5 to $25 with the move to Capital One, which takes a while to reach on a capped 2% card, so statement credits with no minimum are the practical route for smaller balances.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners. Cashback Bonus is cash, not a transferable currency.

protection_note: Nothing here, which holds across every Discover card since the February 2018 cuts and the removal of price protection that October. The live application terms say as much directly, answering no when asked whether anything applies beyond what is disclosed. If you want a card that would replace a phone or a laptop when it breaks, this is not it.
rental_note: No rental car coverage, primary or secondary. Nothing at the counter backs you up, so you would be relying on your own auto policy or buying the waiver.

services.name: No credit score required to apply
services.detail: Discover states outright that no credit score is required, using scores only if you already have them. That is the most useful thing here for a first-time applicant, since the usual catch is needing credit to build credit.

services.name: $0 fraud liability
services.detail: You are never held responsible for unauthorized purchases. No enrollment needed.

services.name: Free FICO score
services.detail: Your FICO score from TransUnion on your statement and in the app, with the factors moving it. Genuinely useful when you are starting from no credit history and want to watch it build.

services.name: Social Security number alerts
services.detail: Daily dark web scans for your SSN plus new-account alerts on your credit report. Requires enrollment, and only the primary cardmember can sign up.

services.name: Freeze It
services.detail: Freeze the account from the app or website to block new purchases and cash advances if you misplace the card.

services.name: Nothing changes when you graduate
services.detail: Discover confirms the account keeps the same terms, rewards and features after you finish college. There is no conversion to a different product and nothing you need to do, contrary to what several comparison sites claim.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Their spending earns cash back into your account
Counts toward your Cashback Match in year one
Any purchase protection or travel coverage

additional_cards.note: Free to add, though the shared $1,000 quarterly cap fills faster with two people on it, and you remain responsible for everything they charge.

timeline.text: When your own account moves to Capital One, three earning routes switch on that Discover never had: 5% on hotels, rental cars, vacation rentals and activities booked through Capital One Travel, 5% on tickets and events through Capital One Entertainment, and Capital One Offers for online shopping. Migration runs in waves into 2027, so these are not live for most cardholders yet, and Discover's own product pages do not list them.

Capital One begins moving Discover card accounts onto its own platform on July 27, in waves running through 2027. Account numbers, existing earn rates, rewards balances, APRs and the Discover network branding all stay put, and migrated accounts also pick up the new Capital One earning routes. Redemption changes though: the gift card minimum rises from $5 to $25, and Pay with Rewards through Apple Pay goes away.
Capital One completes its acquisition of Discover Financial Services. Discover Bank later merges into Capital One, N.A., though the cards keep Discover branding and terms.

Discover drops purchase protection, extended warranty, return guarantee, auto rental collision coverage and travel accident insurance across its consumer cards. This is why the protections section below is empty.
